title: Identification naming a deleted contact
description: QA T16521555. A Type 7 names the fleet's fixture contact that is soft-deleted in Tenna. HARDBRAKE at 30, identification at 70, trip end at 150. Must prove: the row persists as unidentified (no contact) and never becomes the assignee source. Must NOT change: the asset assignee, the trip assignee, or the violation's attribution.
